review: Make Masks outline thickness (2026-10-25): one spin box, in the Display and Mask layers categories, for the width of the mask layers' outlines in image pixels (0.25 to 4, default 1). Preserve the numerals 1, 0.5, 0.25 and the unit px exactly.

records.key: Width of the mask layers' outlines, in image pixels: 1 is the 1 px inner boundary, 0.5 half of it, and 0.25 a hairline. The outline lies inside each object and grows with the zoom like the image; below 1 it is drawn thinner than a pixel, smoothed, so the edge under it stays visible. Display only; saved masks are unchanged.

records.translation: 掩膜图层轮廓的宽度，以图像像素为单位：1 为 1 px 的内边界，0.5 为其一半，0.25 为极细线。轮廓位于每个对象内部，并像图像一样随缩放变粗；小于 1 时以比一个像素更细的平滑线条绘制，使其下方的边缘仍然可见。仅影响显示；已保存的掩膜不变。
